It is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}}, and under the former {{ill|Shakaku|ja|社格|ko|사격 (신토)|zh|社格|qid=Q10444029}} system it was a {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}. {{nihongo|'''Kawamata Shrine'''|河俣神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

It enshrines {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|lt=Kotoshironushi|Q8009611|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kamo-yahae Kotoshironushi-no-Kami}}.

== History ==
In the ''{{ill|Izumo no Kuni no Miyatsuko no Kamuyogoto|ja|出雲国造神賀詞|qid=Q11395857}}'', it says, as a deity protecting the {{ill|Imperial House of Japan|Q909452|qid=Q909452}}, "Seat the august spirit of Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto in the divine provision of Unase." This "Unase" is identified with "Unate," and the shrine is thus identified with the Shikinai Taisha listed in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} as "Kamo Kotoshironushi Shrine seated at Takachi Mikata, Takaichi District, {{ill|Yamato Province|be|Ямата (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Yamato|ckb|پارێزگای یەماتۆ|cs|Provincie Jamato|de|Provinz Yamato|el|Επαρχία Γιαμάτο|es|Provincia de Yamato|fa|ولایت یاماتو|fi|Yamaton provinssi|fr|Province de Yamato|gl|Provincia de Yamato|hak|Yamato-koet|id|Provinsi Yamato|it|Yamato (provincia)|ja|大和国|ko|야마토국|lt|Jamato žemė|nl|Yamato (provincie)|no|Yamato (provins)|pt|Província de Yamato|ro|Provincia Yamato|ru|Ямато (провинция)|simple|Yamato Province|sk|Jamato (provincia)|sr|Провинција Јамато|th|แคว้นยามาโตะ|tr|Yamato (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Ямато|ur|یاماتو صوبہ|zh|大和國|zh_min_nan|Yamato-kok|zh_yue|大和國|qid=Q907495}}" (although the ''Jinmyōchō'' also contains the name "three seats of Kawamata Shrine," this is identified with nearby {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Konoha Shrine}}).

According to the ''{{ill|Nihon Shoki|Q813935|qid=Q813935}}'', during the {{ill|Jinshin War|bg|Войната Джиншин|ca|Guerra Jinshin|es|Guerra Jinshin|fa|شورش جینشین|fr|Guerre de Jinshin|id|Pertempuran Jinshin|it|Guerra jinshin|ja|壬申の乱|ko|진신의 난|pl|Zamieszki roku Jinshin|pt|Guerra Jinshin|ru|Смута года Дзинсин|sh|Džinšinski rat|simple|Jinshin War|sl|Džinšinska vojna|su|Perang Jinshin|th|สงครามจินชิน|tr|Jinshin Savaşı|uk|Смута Дзінсін|vi|Chiến tranh Jinshin|zh|壬申之亂|qid=Q2378252}}, the district chief Takachi Agatanushi Kome was possessed by "Kotoshironushi-no-Kami who dwells at Takachi Shrine" and "Ikumusubi-no-Kami (Ame-ikutama-no-Mikoto) who dwells at {{ill|Musanimasu Shrine|ja|牟佐坐神社|qid=Q38278497|lt=Musa Shrine}}." They delivered an oracle saying, "Offer horses and various weapons to the mausoleum of {{ill|Emperor Jimmu|ar|الإمبراطور جينمو|arz|الامبراطور جينمو|as|জিম্মু|az|Cimmu|bcl|Emperador Jimmu|be|Імператар Дзіму|ca|Jinmu|cdo|Sìng-ū Tiĕng-huòng|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر جینمو|cs|Džimmu|de|Jimmu|el|Αυτοκράτορας Τζίμου|eo|Imperiestro Jinmu|es|Jinmu Tennō|et|Jimmu|eu|Jimmu enperadorea|fa|امپراتور جینمو|fi|Jinmu|fr|Jinmu|hak|Sṳ̀n-vú Thiên-fòng|he|ג'ימו, קיסר יפן|hi|सम्राट जिममु|hr|Jinmu|hu|Dzsinmu japán császár|id|Jimmu|it|Jinmu|ja|神武天皇|jv|Jimmu Tenno|ka|ძიმუ|ko|진무 천황|kw|Emperour Jimmu|la|Jimmu|lt|Imperatorius Džinmu|lv|Džimmu|mn|Эзэн Хаан Жиммү|mr|जिम्मू|ms|Maharaja Jimmu|my|ဂျင်းမူ ဧကရာဇ်|nl|Jimmu|no|Jimmu|pl|Jimmu|pt|Jimmu|ru|Император Дзимму|sh|Car Jimmu|simple|Emperor Jimmu|sl|Cesar Džinmu|sr|Џинму|sv|Jimmu|th|จักรพรรดิจิมมุ|tl|Emperador Jimmu|tr|Jimmu|uk|Імператор Дзімму|uz|Jimmu|vi|Thiên hoàng Jimmu|war|Emperador Jimmu|wuu|神武天皇|zh|神武天皇|zh_classical|神武天皇|zh_min_nan|Sîn-bú Thian-hông|zh_yue|神武天皇|qid=Q200188|lt=Kamuyamatoiwarebiko no Sumeramikoto}}," and promised to protect Prince Ōama (later {{ill|Emperor Tenmu|Q335181|qid=Q335181}}). After Prince Ōama's enthronement, because of this miracle, the first historical conferment of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=divine rank}} was granted to Kamo Kotoshironushi-no-Kami seated at Takachi Mikata. The {{ill|Man'yōshū|Q834321|qid=Q834321}} also contains a poem about this shrine.

At {{ill|Sumiyoshi-taisha|Q705949|qid=Q705949}} ({{ill|Sumiyoshi-ku, Osaka|ar|سومييوشي-كو|ca|Sumiyoshi|eo|Kvartalo Sumijoŝi|es|Sumiyoshi-ku (Osaka)|fa|سومی‌یوشی، اوساکا|fi|Sumiyoshi-ku|fr|Sumiyoshi-ku|it|Sumiyoshi-ku|ja|住吉区|ko|스미요시구|pl|Sumiyoshi (Osaka)|sco|Sumiyoshi-ku, Osaka|th|เขตซูมิโยชิ|tr|Sumiyoshi|zh|住吉區|zh_yue|住吉區|qid=Q985702}}, {{ill|Osaka|Q35765|qid=Q35765}}), there is the clay-taking ritual in the precincts of {{ill|Unebiyamaguchi Shrine|ja|畝火山口神社|qid=Q11578590}}. The person who performs that rite customarily puts on ritual garments at this shrine, and for that reason it is popularly called "the shrine of vestments."
